IDC released a report today, pointing out that Huawei and Apple are the only manufacturers to record shipment growth in the Chinese smartphone market in the second quarter of 2026. Details are as follows.

The results mark the fifth consecutive quarter of year-on-year decline

According to the report, Apple recorded the strongest year-on-year shipment growth among major Chinese smartphone manufacturers in the second quarter of 2026, reaching 24.4%.

This propelled Apple from fifth place to second place, with its market share climbing from 13.9% to 18.1%. Huawei remains firmly in the lead, accounting for 22.6% of smartphone shipments in that quarter.

That said, other major smartphone manufacturers all recorded year-on-year declines, with shipments falling by as much as 60.8%, due to rising memory and component costs, the phase-out of government subsidies, and weaker consumer demand—especially evident during the 618 shopping festival.

Overall, the Chinese smartphone market declined 4.3% year-on-year, with shipments of approximately 66 million units in the quarter.
